newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-MIM says Ernest Henry mine starts.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-MIM says Ernest Henry mine starts.

text.p: MIM Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it has commenced mining operations at its 51 percent-owned Ernest Henry copper and gold mine in Queensland state.
The mine would eventaully work up to an production rate of 95,000 tonnes of copper and 120,000 ounces of gold, MIM said.
Savage Resources Ltd owns the remaining 49 percent interest in the mine.

MIM said contractors had started full-scale pre-stripping of the mine and anticipated that ore will be mined beginning next March ahead of the commissioning of a processing plant in the second half of calendar 1997.
MIM in October said development of Ernest Henry would proceed despite potential native title claims that have threatened to halt the project.

Sancave Pty Ltd, a company associated with Aboriginal interests, has sought A$120 million to ensure no native title claims are lodged against the A$350 million project, a proposal that has been rejected by MIM. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
